source_event.summary: Independent audit found client selected-scope propagation without exact server-side active-scope enforcement.

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A mutating client can propagate a selected tenant/account scope while the server authorizes only the global actor plus resource id.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat client scope propagation as sufficient authorization evidence.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Resolve active authority for the exact selected scope, bind the target resource to it, and revalidate mutable authority/state at commit.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Require same-actor different-scope, revoked-authority and concurrent-state sibling cases.

transfer_cases.scenario: Same account, invoice from another selected workspace must be rejected before side effects.
Same practitioner, record from another selected organization must be rejected at commit.

skill_changes.evidence: General selected-scope server enforcement rule remains part of the delivery contract.
Attack matrix/risk saturation retain authorization/isolation and sibling controls.
